'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Philippe Dubreuil DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Philippe Dubreuil]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Worlds Day 2 ASM 1.5[1]. Typed Holotable 'Worlds Day 2 ASM 1.5[1]'; handwritten Philippe Dubreuil Day 2 Dark. Fanfare (V) (1 starting) crossed out; Death Star Sentry (V) written in. Page 2 is the remaining starting shields. (AI) on Jango Fett The Assassin, Galen Marek Starkiller, and The Phantom Menace — uniqueness stars / AI flags stripped. MagnaGuard printed with triple-star. Reserve qty 60 excluding shields.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
